text:
maria: Flagging — we still don't have a tight contract for transient vs sticky errors at the routing layer. UX wants a minimal surface so SDKs can auto-adjust retries/backoff and the console can show quota impact. Thoughts?

aj: Agree we need something small and stable. Too many codes + freeform strings -> chaos.

tobias: Proposal: a compact error-kind header clients can read. Keep it orthogonal to HTTP status. e.g.:
```
x-rw-error-kind: transient|sticky|quota|routing
x-rw-retry-hint-ms: 1500   # optional numeric hint for clients
x-rw-quota-delta: -120    # optional tokens consumed/overage
```
This lets SDKs pick strategy without leaking internals.

nina: Love the header but we also need telemetry keys so console can slice by kind. Suggest adding metric tags: error_kind=(transient|sticky|quota|routing), route_id, model_variant, tenant_id.

kevin: +1. From routing POV, "sticky" should mean the request hit a terminal condition for this route (e.g., tenant throttle or unavailable variant) and should not be retried quickly. Transient = short retry ok.

maria: Important privacy note: don't expose raw internal reasons (e.g., "kv-cache-miss" or "oom-gpu") — only the high-level bucket. Keep mapping internal->public in gateway.

aj: SDK behaviour proposal:
- transient -> exponential backoff (initial 300ms, *2, jitter)
- sticky -> fail fast to app, include guidance string from server if available
- quota -> surface quota UI state and include quota_deltas header so apps can decrement local counters

tobias: For rollout UX: when we flip a variant canary, we should annotate telemetry with rollout_tag so console can correlate increased sticky errors to rollout. Also add percentage sampling for full logs.

nina: Dashboard requests: make a small "Error Kind" stacked area (transient/sticky/quota/routing) and a per-route rate of sticky conversions. Also a list of tenants with rising sticky rate.

kevin: Edge case: some 5xx are ambiguous (e.g., transient backend timeout vs overloaded model). We should prefer transient unless we detect tenant-level rate-gating -> then sticky. Need to document detection heuristics.

maria: Could we send a short human-help string for sticky/quota like: "quota exceeded: upgrade plan" or "route disabled: contact support"? Keep it terse, localized later.

aj: Yes but limit to 140 chars and sanitize. Console will map server_hint -> help links.

ops-bot: deploy: routing-gateway v1.9.3 promoted to prod (canary 10%). No errors exceeding threshold in first 15m. :white_check_mark:

kevin: One more: SDKs should add a metrics hook so apps can report client-side retry behavior into our telemetry (to close the loop).

product-bot: Can we get a small RFC doc for this? Product wants the UX flows (what the console surfaces) + the SDK mapping.

maria: I'll draft an RFC with headers, detection heuristics, and dashboard mockups. Will ping for review.

aj: Thx. Quick checklist for RFC: public header names, allowed values, numeric hint semantics, telemetry tag names, example mappings to HTTP statuses, SDK pseudocode.

tobias: + add rollout tagging and sampling guidance.

maria: Filing now. Expect first pass in ~24h. :sparkles:

kevin: tl;dr — one small header + telemetry tags + SDK mapping = much less confusion.

maria: Exactly. Keep it minimal.
